tail:
Completed batch 55: authored 12 items across the A/B pages and updated the manifest, source coverage, proof contracts, notes, and readiness records.

Eight items are marked ready; four are escalated: the ordinary CoHA definition and theorem, and the critical CoHA definition and theorem. Their unresolved prerequisite is the quotient-stack Borel–Moore operation package for the parabolic-to-Levi and parabolic-to-general-linear maps, including degree normalization and base-change coherence. The critical items also lack a proved standard vanishing-cycle realization. The precise gaps and proposed owner suppliers are recorded in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-55.notes.md).

Validation passed: author check, focused dependency checks, proof precheck, proof layout (7 items, 27 steps), strict contracts (12/12), coverage (2 pages, 35 harvested results), and source fetch verification (8/8).

The run-wide batch dependency check remains blocked by a YAML parser error in batch 51 item `lem-hall-and-dj-borel-conventions-are-isomorphic`. Batch 55’s own dependency graph is acyclic and passes with levels 0–5; the unrelated item was not edited.

Carriers: [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/hall-algebras-and-tensor-categories/cohomological-hall-algebras-and-quiver-correspondences.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/hall-algebras-and-tensor-categories/cohomological-hall-algebras-and-quiver-correspondences-examples.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-55.pages.json), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-55.proof-contracts.json).
